title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
The ideal candidate is a self-motivated, multi-tasker, and demonstrated team player. You will be a lead developer responsible for the development of new software products and enhancements to existing products. You should excel in working with large-scale applications and frameworks and have outstanding communication and leadership skills.



Responsibilities

• Design and build robust, scalable backend services using modern engineering principles;

• Apply best practices to ensure maintainability, performance, reliability, and security;

• Develop and maintain services using C# and .NET;

• Work with Azure Cloud Services and deploy solutions on Azure infrastructure;

• Design and operate cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes;

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps;

• Develop tooling to create and import test data for efficient test setup;

• Implement end-to-end and scale test automation;

• Write, execute, and evaluate API and service-level automated tests;

• Collaborate closely with Microsoft and internal stakeholders;

• Take shared ownership of code quality, testing, and operational excellence.


Required Skills & Experience


• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience;

• Fluent English with strong communication skills;

• 5+ years of experience as a Senior Software Engineer or 10+ years as a Principal Software Engineer;

• Strong experience in building scalable backend systems;

• Proficiency in C# / .NET • Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services;

• Experience with Kubernetes and cloud deployments on Azure;

• Solid understanding of DevOps practices, including: Azure DevOps, build and release pipelines, experience with NoSQL databases and Azure Data Lake Storage;

• Strong background in test automation, including API, service, and end-to-end testing;

• Experience with development tools such as Visual Studio, VS Code, GitHub, and Azure DevOps (ADO);

• Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools;

• Experience with Microsoft Dataverse, Core Services, and the Power Platform is a strong plus.

tuning)

the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

• Experience working with European teams.

• Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.

Soft skills

title: Realistic Illustrator (Puzzle Art)
description:
About the Role

Mosaic is a fast-growing puzzle company producing highly detailed, realistic illustrations designed for immersive storytelling experiences. We are looking for a technically strong illustrator with a realistic style who thrives in structured production environments and enjoys iterative creative processes.

This role is ideal for illustrators who:

  • Have the ability to separate personal style from production needs and iterate based on clear feedback.
  • Enjoy building complex and maximalist narrative scenes.
  • Are comfortable working from detailed briefs developed by the art department.
  • Deliver consistent, high-quality work within defined production timelines.
  • Adapt seamlessly to a range of techniques and visual approaches within a realistic illustration style.


 Responsibilities
  • Create high-quality, detailed digital illustrations for our puzzles in a realistic style
  • Work collaboratively with our creative team to develop concepts and ideas.
  • Meet production targets and deadlines while ensuring the illustrations meet our standards for quality and consistency.
  • Communication with art and production teams to ensure illustrations are delivered on time and pass our quality checks.


 Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating realistic, detailed illustration work
  • Experience working with brands, studios, or commercial clients (not only personal projects)
  • High technical skill in composition, perspective, lighting, and color
  • Proven ability to illustrate complex scenes with storytelling elements
  • Availability to work full-time on a fixed schedule (10am–6pm overlap)
  • Comfortable with daily feedback and multiple revision rounds
  • Production mindset and ability to meet deadlines consistently
  • Advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, Illustrator, or equivalent professional digital illustration tools


 Nice to Have
  • Experience creating artwork for puzzles, games, publishing, or complex visual products
  • Comfort using AI tools for ideation and reference gathering
  • Experience working inside structured creative pipelines


Application Instructions (MANDATORY)

Applications without ALL of the following will not be reviewed:

  • Portfolio with at least 2/3 examples of realistic, highly detailed multi-element scenes (not studies or single characters).
  • Resume or CV

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação, Cuiabá - MT.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação, Cuiabá - MT.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Full Stack Developer (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar na criação e evolução de produtos digitais utilizados globalmente, trabalhando tanto no front-end quanto no back-end, desenvolvendo APIs, microsserviços, integrações e melhorias de performance.

A função envolve participação ativa em decisões técnicas, colaboração com times ágeis, uso de ferramentas e tecnologias modernas e foco em entregas escaláveis, de qualidade e com boa experiência para o usuário.

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações back-end e front-end , além de microsserviços, utilizando tecnologias modernas para construir ferramentas amigáveis ao usuário.
  • Utilizar integração contínua visando deployment contínuo, escrevendo códigos reutilizáveis e de fácil manutenção.
  • Desenvolver APIs e serviços REST .
  • Melhorar e otimizar aplicações atuais , garantindo maior valor ao cliente, melhor experiência do usuário e aumento de performance (por exemplo, reduzindo tempo de resposta e atualizando o stack tecnológico).
  • Integrar soluções de softwares terceirizados , alinhando-se com fornecedores sobre integração, manutenção e melhorias.
  • Escrever código limpo e funcional tanto no front-end quanto no back-end, além de documentação correspondente.
  • Compartilhar aprendizados e sugestões com o time sobre como melhorar aplicações, simplificar códigos e garantir consistência do sistema.
  • Assegurar compatibilidade e otimização entre diferentes plataformas.
  • Realizar testes (unitários e de integração), manter o design responsivo das aplicações e melhorar continuamente a qualidade do código.

Experiências Requeridas

  • Mínimo de 6 anos desenvolvendo aplicações amigáveis para múltiplos dispositivos.
  • Mínimo de 3 anos trabalhando em times ágeis em escala.
  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Solutions Architect – Manufacturing & Supply Chain
description:
Quick Overview

Our client is seeking Solutions Architects to lead technical implementation projects and support client success initiatives in the manufacturing and supply chain industry. This is a client-facing role requiring strong communication skills, technical expertise, and experience delivering software and integration solutions. The role involves managing projects from requirements gathering to deployment, supporting both new and existing clients, and ensuring successful system implementation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical lead for new client implementations and ongoing client requests
  • Evaluate integration between hardware and software and assess operational performance for successful implementation
  • Assist with projects from requirements definition through deployment, including scheduling and scope documentation
  • Maintain technical design documentation for software changes and development
  • Consult with customers regarding software design, development, and necessary modifications
  • Communicate internal deliverables and change requests to stakeholders
  • Analyze, design, and document system implementation changes
  • Coordinate project resources to meet milestones and ensure successful delivery
  • Collaborate across departments to ensure implementation success
  • Understand business impacts of issues and advise on IT solutions


Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven track record in technology solution implementation
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple implementations and requests concurrently
  • Collaborative team player with a customer-centered mindset
  • Experience with freight rate and auditing software, SQL, Jira, or other ticket management systems
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet and Atlassian Suite
  • Experience with release processes and SDLC
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, MIS, Business, or related field
  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in implementation or client success

title: Arquiteto de Soluções
description:
A Dexian é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a Dexian atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente líder desde 1955 no segmento automotivo.


Requisitos:

Arquitetura: C4, DDD (tático/estratégico), Event Driven, API First, SOA, patterns de integração.

SAP S/4HANA: IDoc, BAPI, RFC, OData, SAP CPI/Integration Suite, extensibility, segurança e autorização.

Integração: APIs REST, webhooks, mensageria, ETL/ELT, API gateways.

SaaS: análise de aderência, riscos, extensibilidade, integração e modelos de dados.

Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP (preferência AWS), redes, IAM, segurança, observabilidade.

Linguagens: familiaridade com múltiplos ecossistemas (Java, .NET, Node, Python etc.).

Segurança: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, MFA, criptografia, governança de dados.

Ferramentas: Draw.io, LeanIX, Git, Jira, AzureDevops, Postman, Swagger.


Experiência prática com integrações entre sistemas legados e SAP S/4HANA .

Histórico em projetos SaaS e ambientes híbridos .

Participação em decisões de aquisição ou desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Experiência na construção de artefatos arquiteturais para governança.


Diferencial:

Inglês Avançado.


Onde vc vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Regime de Contratação:

Flexível.

title: SR Fullstack Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients.


We’re looking for a Senior FullStack Engineer with strong expertise in .NET, Azure, and modern frontend frameworks to join a dynamic and innovative team supporting Experian Employer Services. If you enjoy building scalable applications, working across the full stack, and contributing to cloud-native solutions this role is for you:


What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in .NET development (C#, .NET Core)
  • Strong backend expertise (APIs, integrations, microservices, SQL Server)
  • Strong frontend experience (HTML, CSS, JavaScript + Angular or React )
  • Experience with Azure (IaaS/SaaS) & Azure DevOps pipelines
  • Knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns


What You’ll Do

  • Design and build new features across the full stack (backend + frontend)
  • Develop clean, high-quality code using C#, .NET Framework, and .NET Core
  • Build and modernize APIs, integrations, and microservices
  • Develop responsive UIs using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular or React
  • Work with SQL Server and relational database design
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and follow secure SDLC practices
  • Participate in code reviews and troubleshoot issues efficiently
  • Work with Azure cloud services and CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Engineering teams


Want to change the world? Let us know.

  • Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

title: Especialista em Energia  – Setor Elétrico e Transição Energética
description:
OBJETIVO:

Integrar a equipe técnica do Instituto E+ com atuação transversal em temas do setor elétrico, apoiando estudos, projetos, formulação de posições institucionais e interlocução técnica com stakeholders do setor.


PERFIL GERAL

Buscamos uma pessoa com autonomia, capacidade de execução, visão sistêmica do setor elétrico e flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes temas. Não é uma oportunidade puramente acadêmica nem exclusivamente regulatória — valorizamos perfil prático, resolutivo e colaborativo.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoiar e desenvolver estudos técnicos e estratégicos sobre o setor elétrico brasileiro
  • Contribuir para análises sobre mercado de energia, regulação e transição energética
  • Participar da elaboração de posicionamentos institucionais e notas técnicas
  • Apoiar projetos relacionados à modernização do setor, renováveis, GD, armazenamento, planejamento e governança
  • Interagir com stakeholders (governo, reguladores, empresas, academia e sociedade civil)
  • Contribuir para atividades do Instituto em fóruns e iniciativas nacionais e internacionais


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Energia, Economia da Energia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia no setor elétrico brasileiro
  • Conhecimento desejável em:

-Mercado de energia (ACL, ACR, PLD)

- Regulação e funcionamento do setor (CCEE, ONS, ANEEL, EPE)

- Mecanismos como MRE, comercialização, contratos, formação de preços

  • Capacidade analítica e de síntese
  • Boa redação técnica


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com transição energética, renováveis, armazenamento, GD ou planejamento energético
  • Experiência com modelos do setor elétrico (ex.: despacho, expansão, simulação de mercado, otimização, modelos energéticos ou de sistema elétrico)
  • Experiência em consultoria, think tanks, reguladores ou comercializadoras
  • Capacidade de transitar entre análise técnica e visão estratégica
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Fluência em Inglês

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Senior
description:
Título da vaga: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior – Especialista em CRM


O Wite Group, em conjunto com sua frente tecnológica WiteTec, desenvolve soluções orientadas a performance, automação e escala operacional para empresas que precisam de previsibilidade e eficiência real. Nosso ambiente é altamente técnico, orientado a entrega e responsabilidade sobre produção, onde qualidade de código, arquitetura sólida e visão de impacto de negócio não são diferenciais, mas exigências básicas.


A posição de Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior é estratégica e exige domínio técnico profundo, visão arquitetural e capacidade comprovada de resolver problemas complexos em sistemas críticos. Buscamos um profissional que atue com autonomia total, consiga diagnosticar gargalos estruturais, propor soluções escaláveis e implementar melhorias com segurança e precisão. Essa função envolve participação ativa na evolução de produtos, construção de integrações robustas, otimização de performance e garantia de estabilidade de sistemas, principalmente aqueles ligados a CRM e operações comerciais.


Esperamos domínio avançado de desenvolvimento full stack, arquitetura de sistemas, APIs, bancos de dados, integrações complexas, versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia de software. É indispensável experiência real com plataformas de CRM, customizações, automações, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integrações entre múltiplos sistemas. O perfil comportamental ideal demonstra pensamento lógico estruturado, responsabilidade técnica elevada, capacidade de priorização, comunicação clara, postura analítica e mentalidade de dono sobre o produto e o código.


A remuneração é de R$12.000,00 e buscamos um profissional que sustente padrão técnico alto, entregue soluções robustas e responda diretamente pela qualidade e confiabilidade do que desenvolve. Aqui, senioridade não é tempo de carreira — é capacidade real de resolver problemas complexos com consistência.

title: Global Executive Recrutier
description:
Global Executive Recrutier - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM – 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience with Hunting in the North-American Market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus


Nice to Have

  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Technical Customer Support (LATAM)
description:
*Resume MUST be in English, or it will not be processed


Location: LATAM

Team: Customer Support

Role: Technical Customer Support (LATAM)

Mode: Remote


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: NOC - 1st/2nd Line Support
description:
NOC - 1st/2nd Line Support

**Supporting USA Time Zone**


Skills

  • MUST have Network Operations Centre experience
  • Incident Management - Troubleshoot and Raise Tickets
  • Linux Environment (Commands)
  • Python Scripting
  • Cloud - GCP/AWS


Overview

We are seeking an experienced NOC Support Analyst to join our 24/7 monitoring team. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive system monitoring , first‑line troubleshooting , and escalation to second‑ and third‑line teams when required. Each shift is staffed by two engineers, with one acting as the Manager on Duty (MOD) .


This position is ideal for someone with solid NOC experience who is also looking for career growth opportunities in Automation , SRE , and systems optimisation .


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, and services to ensure availability and performance.
  • Perform initial triage and first‑line troubleshooting of incidents.
  • Escalate issues appropriately after initial diagnosis.
  • Act as Manager on Duty when assigned, coordinating incident response.
  • Contribute to automation improvements , tooling enhancements , and SRE initiatives .
  • Support staging and pre‑production activities aimed at improving production stability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to refine processes and reduce manual intervention.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or similar operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring tools, incident workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, 24/7 environment with shared responsibility across shifts.


Ideal Candidate Profile

This role may be a great fit for:

  • A Junior Software Engineer with an interest in operational systems, automation, and reliability engineering.
  • Someone eager to grow into an SRE -focused position through hands-on exposure and mentorship.
  • A candidate passionate about operational excellence and continuously improving system reliability.

title: Designer de multimídia
description:
Buscamos um(a) Designer talentoso(a) e com múltiplas competências para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota. O profissional ideal é apaixonado por criar soluções visuais que comunicam, engajam e fortalecem a presença das marcas que atendemos no ambiente digital e fora dele. Se você tem um portfólio que demonstra criatividade, versatilidade e um olhar estratégico sobre design, queremos conhecer seu trabalho!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e criar conceitos visuais para campanhas de marketing, redes sociais e anúncios de performance (tráfego pago).
  • Produzir materiais gráficos diversos, desde peças digitais até layouts para impressão, garantindo a qualidade e o alinhamento com os objetivos.
  • Editar e animar vídeos curtos e dinâmicos para plataformas como Instagram (Reels), TikTok e YouTube Shorts, transformando ideias em conteúdo audiovisual de impacto.
  • Zelar pela consistência e evolução da nossa identidade visual em todos os pontos de contato da marca.


Requisitos:


  • Portfólio sólido que demonstre sua experiência em design gráfico e, idealmente, em motion graphics/edição de vídeo.
  • Domínio de softwares da suíte Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) ou ferramentas equivalentes do mercado.
  • Profundo conhecimento dos fundamentos do design: tipografia, teoria das cores, composição e hierarquia visual.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar projetos e prazos de forma autônoma, com organização e proatividade, em um ambiente de trabalho remoto.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação para colaborar com a equipe e entender briefings.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Experiência com criação de criativos que convertem (foco em performance).
  • Habilidades em ilustração ou animação 2D.
  • Noções de UX/UI para projetos web ou de aplicativos.


Informações Adicionais:


  • Modalidade: 100% Remoto
  • Tipo de Contratação: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)
  • Remuneração: A combinar

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer


Experience with senior level software engineering and specifically around databases, API management including GraphQL and experience with containers and cloud services such as AWS or OCI.


Must Have:

GraphQL Very Strong

Back end coding

API

AWS


Role Details:

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable cloudbased GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms

This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion processing and delivery system integrating streaming data and highperformance querying

Youll work closely with crossfunctional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem Your DaytoDay Build new foundational capabilities using domaindriven design and testdriven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties

Help lead team members in the design development and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture Participate in scrum ceremonies daily standups grooming and sprint planning

Practice DevOps writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring Review your teammates designs and code providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions including weekly deep dive sessions on various topics

Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration Key Projects Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products ingesting processing and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem

Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management Qualifications What you bring to the team You have 5 years of experience in data engineering and data system development Experience in designing implementing and maintaining GraphQL schemas optimizing query performance and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences

Experience with JavascriptTypeScript Python Nodejs Experience with relational NoSQL and keyvalue data stores such as Aurora MySQL DynamoDB MongoDB Redis Handson experience working in a distributed cloudbased environment AWS preferred with high transaction volumes using a variety of connected services Proficiency with modern build strategies continuous integration unit testing and automated integration tests GitHub issue tracking tools Jira and CICD related disciplines GitOps

Ability to design solutions provide estimates and evaluate risk and technical feasibility

BS Computer Science Engineering a related technical degree or equivalent professional experience You might also have Wundergraph Cosmo or Apollo GraphQL experience AWS Certifications

Experience with extract transform load ETL pipelines using data orchestration platforms cloud services and frameworks a plus

Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation

Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering product and architecture Energetic selfstarter who can work in a complex collaborative environment that rewards innovation initiative curiosity and mentoring Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Role Details

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design and build a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer responsible for delivering sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms.

This role focuses on developing a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery ecosystem, integrating streaming data with high-performance querying capabilities.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture that supports the evolution of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Build foundational capabilities using domain-driven design (DDD) and test-driven development (TDD) to power features across CBS Sports digital properties.

Lead the design, development, and optimization of GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.

Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.

Apply DevOps best practices by writing high-quality tests and deploying continuously to production with strong observability and monitoring standards.

Review peer designs and code, provide constructive feedback, and engage in technical deep-dive discussions.

Partner with product teams to design technical solutions leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects

Build a scalable GraphQL API to enable seamless data access and integration across services.

Design and implement a core data platform that ingests, processes, and stores data from hundreds of sources across various transports and data stores.

Define and implement distributed tracing and observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.

Containerize core systems to optimize infrastructure management and deployment efficiency.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of experience in data engineering and data systems development.

Strong experience designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring efficient data retrieval.

Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Node.js.

Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as Aurora MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, and Redis.

Experience working in distributed, cloud-based environments, preferably AWS, supporting high transaction volumes.

Proficiency with modern build strategies, CI/CD pipelines, unit and integration testing, GitHub, Jira, and GitOps practices.

Ability to design scalable solutions, estimate effort, and assess technical risks and feasibility.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

Experience with Wundergraph Cosmo or Apollo GraphQL.

AWS certifications.

Experience with ETL pipelines, data orchestration platforms, and cloud-based data frameworks.

Background in digital media or online content platforms.

Strong collaboration skills, proactive mindset, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Knowledge of sports and gaming is a plus.

title: Assistente administrativo de coordenação de eventos
description:
Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui.

Descrição do Cargo Buscamos um Assistente Administrativo de Coordenação de Eventos para integrar nossa equipe em regime remoto. As principais responsabilidades incluem apoiar a organização e execução de eventos, garantir a comunicação eficaz entre os participantes e fornecedores e acompanhar todas as etapas necessárias para o sucesso dos eventos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral voltado para pessoas organizadas e proativas, com habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas.

Qualificações

  • Planejamento e Gerenciamento de Eventos : Experiência em planejamento e execução de eventos, incluindo organização de logísticas e resolução de problemas em tempo hábil.
  • Comunicação e Organização: Habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes internas, fornecedores e clientes. Organização de documentos, planilhas, informações e grupos de comunicação
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Capacidade de fornecer excelente atendimento ao cliente, assegurando a satisfação e suportando suas necessidades.
  • Competências adicionais, como experiência com ferramentas de organização de eventos e proficiência em idiomas estrangeiros, serão diferenciais importantes.

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Desenvolvimento para nuvem
  • Backend Java
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST
  • Testes unitários, integrados, API e front
  • Docker e Kubernetes
  • Banco de dados relacional e SQL (DB2/Oracle)
  • Observabilidade e monitoração
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes
  • Integração em times ágeis, participando de cerimônias como planning e retrospectivas


O que fazer em seguida:

  • Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Especialista Celonis Sênior
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Sobre a posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Celonis Sênior com atuação sólida e comprovada na plataforma, capaz de liderar iniciativas de Process Mining ponta a ponta, desde modelagem de dados até geração de insights estratégicos para o negócio.


Esse(a) profissional será referência técnica em Celonis, atuando em ambiente SaaS e integrado a sistemas corporativos (ERP, financeiro, compras, compliance), com forte domínio de PQL e arquitetura de dados dentro da ferramenta.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar como referência técnica em Celonis na organização.
  • Liderar iniciativas de Process Mining e melhoria de processos.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados, conexões, jobs e tabelas.
  • Criar análises avançadas e KPIs utilizando PQL.
  • Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais.
  • Desenvolver e manter action flows e automações.
  • Trabalhar na integração do Celonis com ERPs e outras plataformas.
  • Conduzir reuniões com stakeholders e lideranças.
  • Traduzir necessidades estratégicas em soluções técnicas na ferramenta.
  • Garantir governança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.

title: RippleX Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX's roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.g., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.g., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong "ownership mindset" to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Talent Acquisition Specialist para liderar e executar o recrutamento ponta a ponta na Klavi, garantindo a atração e contratação de talentos de alta performance, alinhados à nossa cultura, valores e ritmo de crescimento.

Essa pessoa terá papel estratégico na escala dos times, atuando como parceira próxima das lideranças e do time de People.

Cultura Klavi

Busca incansável pela excelência:

Somos automotivados, inconformados com o status quo e sempre buscamos evoluir. Cada pessoa deve ser referência em sua área e no negócio como um todo. Elevamos constantemente o padrão de qualidade dos nossos produtos, serviços e processos.

Inovar para revolucionar:

Incentivamos a curiosidade e o questionamento. Estamos abertos a novas ideias e não temos medo de mudanças.

Construção coletiva e reconhecimento compartilhado:

Colaboramos, celebramos conquistas juntos e agimos com transparência, respeito e confiança. Não reclamamos — resolvemos problemas em conjunto.

Foco no sucesso do cliente:

Nosso sucesso depende do sucesso dos nossos clientes. Buscamos sempre superar expectativas e gerar valor de longo prazo.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ser responsável pelo recrutamento end-to-end de posições técnicas e não técnicas, desde o alinhamento de perfil até a oferta e transição para onboarding.
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) do time de People e das lideranças, ajudando a definir prioridades, perfis, senioridade e expectativas de mercado.
  • Desenhar e executar estratégias de sourcing ativo para atrair talentos qualificados, utilizando múltiplos canais (LinkedIn, outbound search, networking, comunidades e referrals).
  • Conduzir entrevistas estruturadas e avaliações comportamentais e técnicas, garantindo decisões consistentes e justas.
  • Atuar como advisor de hiring managers, trazendo visão de mercado, benchmarks salariais e recomendações de contratação.
  • Garantir uma excelente experiência para candidatos(as) em todas as etapas do processo seletivo.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos, ferramentas e rituais de recrutamento, com foco em escala, eficiência e qualidade.
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de recrutamento (time-to-hire, qualidade de contratação, pipeline, candidate experience), utilizando dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de employer branding e posicionamento da Klavi como empregadora no mercado.
  • Contribuir com outras iniciativas de People quando necessário, especialmente ligadas a crescimento organizacional.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Talent Acquisition, preferencialmente em startups, scale-ups ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Experiência prática com recrutamento de posições técnicas e de negócio, incluindo sourcing ativo.
  • Alta autonomia, senso de ownership e capacidade de gerir múltiplas vagas simultaneamente.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e habilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido (3x por semana no escritório) em São Paulo (Av. Paulista – estação Brigadeiro), com os 3 primeiros meses 100% presenciais.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Contrato: PJ

Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: Medical Affairs Specialist
description:
Gene Solutions is a pioneering biotechnology company redefining the future of genetic testing and precision medicine. Headquartered in Singapore, the company has rapidly expanded beyond APAC into the United States and is now entering new markets across Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

By integrating Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Gene Solutions offers a comprehensive portfolio of advanced genetic solutions that empower reproductive health, enable multi-cancer early detection, and support precision oncology.

Our Mission

As Gene Solutions expands globally, our mission remains clear: Bring World-class Genomics Closer to All.

We are committed to making genetic testing more accessible, affordable, and clinically impactful-empowering physicians and patients worldwide through innovation, collaboration, and cutting-edge science.

If you're passionate about advancing healthcare, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact through medical AI, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of medicine.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide medical and scientific expertise on gene testing products in Oncology to internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Develop and review medical materials, including scientific presentations, educational materials, and publications.
  • Support the planning and execution of medical education programs, advisory boards, and scientific symposia.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to generate and disseminate clinical evidence, including study protocols, data analyses, and publications.
  • Serve as a liaison between the company and healthcare professionals, academic institutions, and key opinion leaders in Oncology
  • Stay abreast of scientific literature, clinical guidelines, and competitive landscape in the relevant therapeutic area.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Medical degree (MD, MBBS, or equivalent) with specialization in Oncology, or related field.
  • Previous experience in medical affairs, clinical research, or healthcare consulting within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Strong understanding of genetic testing, molecular diagnostics, and their applications in Oncology.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex scientific concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and strategic thinking in medical affairs activities.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

title: Supervisor de loja
description:

Criamos pijamas e peças homewear com qualidade e design alinhado às tendências, para que você aproveite o melhor da vida com quem ama.   • Desenvolver estratégias para atingir e superar as metas de vendas e rentabilidade.

  • Realizar treinamentos e feedbacks para garantir o desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes.
  • Assegurar a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, alinhada com os padrões da empresa.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes e políticas da marca em todas as lojas.

Principais Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento de varejo de moda.

  • Habilidade com ferramentas de controle (Excel e sistemas de vendas).
  • Vivência em estratégias de visual merchandising e processos de loja.
  • Liderança e capacidade de gestão de pessoas.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Visão estratégica e habilidade para resolução de problemas.
  • Perfil dinâmico, pró-ativo e com alta capacidade de organização.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens entre as lojas sob sua responsabilidade.

Benefícios:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Experiência com processos de Learning & Development.
  • Vivência com administração de LMS (preferencialmente dentro de ecosistemas estruturados).
  • Conhecimento básico de gestão de projetos, logística e organização de treinamentos.

  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas.

Diferenciais

Na Stellantis, avaliamos os candidatos com base em qualificações, mérito e necessidades do negócio. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, idade, etnia, nacionalidade, religião, orientação sexual e deficiência. Equipes diversas nos permitirão responder melhor às necessidades emergentes dos nossos clientes e cuidar do nosso futuro.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.

Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company's various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company's strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule

  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year

Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. title: Audio Producer II
description:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Projetos - EPC
description:
Sobre a Vallourec

Inovação. Tecnologia e Sustentabilidade.

Na Vallourec, somos mais do que uma empresa: somos um parceiro confiável que cria soluções inovadoras para os setores de energia, indústria e construção.

Com mais de 120 anos de história, presença em 20 países nos cinco continentes e mais de 13.000 colaboradores, estamos na vanguarda da tecnologia e da sustentabilidade.

Nossa atuação abrange:

Óleo e Gás – soluções para exploração e extração nas condições mais extremas

Indústria – tubos resistentes e leves para diversas aplicações

Novas Energias – geotermia, hidrogênio e captura de carbono (CCUS)

Com espírito pioneiro, investimos em digitalização, serviços inteligentes e soluções para a transição energética, mantendo nossa liderança tecnológica e criando valor para nossos clientes.

No Brasil, contamos com uma sólida atuação e unidades estratégicas:

Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Espírito Santo – produção de tubos de aço com e sem costura e soluções tubulares para indústria em geral

Florestal – produção de carvão vegetal para abastecimento dos altos-fornos

Mineração – fornecimento interno de minério de ferro

Com presença global e forte atuação local, nosso objetivo é estar cada vez mais próximo dos clientes, garantindo competitividade, inovação e excelência.

Sobre a posição:

A Vallourec busca um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Projetos – EPC para atuar em iniciativas de alta complexidade, liderando projetos estratégicos de engenharia e contribuindo diretamente para a inovação e a excelência operacional da companhia.

Valorizamos segurança, desenvolvimento contínuo, ambiente colaborativo e diversidade.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Planejar, executar e monitorar projetos do portfólio de engenharia, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Atuar com todas as partes interessadas (Investimentos, Suprimentos, Clientes internos, fornecedores e áreas técnicas) assegurando o cumprimento da carteira de investimentos.
  • Definir escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e entregáveis, elaborando planos de projeto completos e estruturados.
  • Gerir o portfólio de projetos: priorização, alocação de recursos, reporte de status, mitigação de riscos e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Aplicar metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMI/PMBOK, Agile), adaptando práticas de acordo com o contexto de cada iniciativa.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação completa em Engenharia com CREA ativo.
  • Experiência sólida com gestão de projetos industriais de médio e grande porte (preferencialmente: siderurgia, metalurgia ou óleo e gás), com interface multidisciplinar (Elétrica, Automação, Mecânica ou Civil).
  • Vivência com controle de custos, planejamento, elaboração e acompanhamento de cronogramas.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas MS Project, Primavera e Power BI.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas.
  • Conhecimento geral de normas técnicas e padrões de Engenharia.

Será considerado diferencial

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo, com foco em bem-estar, segurança e desenvolvimento contínuo:

  • Remuneração variável
  • PLR
  • Previdência privada

  • Cooperativa de crédito (COOVALL)
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação
  • Ambiente inovador e oportunidades de carreira global
